visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: 16:9 video poster card with play button and caption, left column
visualCharacteristics.structure: 2 equal columns: media card (poster + caption) | heading + paragraph(s) + CTA
visualCharacteristics.columns: 2 on desktop, stacked on mobile (media first)

contentPattern: Spotlight: one row, two cells. Cell 1 media: poster image (Scene7) + link to the video (Scene7 SmartCropVideoViewer URL or mp4) + caption paragraph ('Impact that matters: Climate and Nature'). Cell 2 text: heading, paragraph(s), optional CTA link ('Read more') or icon contact line. Section H1 ('Spotlight on') is default content above the block.
